package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/xianxu/ariadne/cmd/sdlc/internal/processgroup"
	"github.com/xianxu/ariadne/cmd/sdlc/internal/queuegate"
)

func main() {
	root, allowed := os.Getenv("WF_SDLC_QUEUE_ROOT"), os.Getenv("PAIR722_PROBE_ALLOWED_ROOT")
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(allowed, root)
	if allowed == "" || root == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(root) || err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, "../") {
		panic("private fixture root required")
	}
	s := &queuegate.Store{Root: root}
	leases := map[string]*queuegate.Lease{}
	defer func() {
		for _, l := range leases {
			_ = l.Retire(context.Background(), "")
			_ = l.Close()
		}
	}()
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var req struct {
			Action, ID string
			Kinds      []string
		}
		out := map[string]any{}
		e := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &req)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
		if e == nil {
			switch req.Action {
			case "enroll":
				started, startErr := processgroup.StartTime(os.Getpid())
				if startErr != nil {
					panic(startErr)
				}
				op := queuegate.Operation{SchemaVersion: 1, ID: req.ID, Workspace: "fixture:0", Head: "pair722-private-head", Kinds: req.Kinds, Phase: "waiting", PID: os.Getpid(), PIDStarted: started, Managed: true, StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Root: os.Getenv("PAIR722_PROBE_CWD")}
				var l *queuegate.Lease
				l, e = s.Enroll(ctx, op)
				if e == nil {
					leases[req.ID] = l
				}
			case "admit":
				if l := leases[req.ID]; l != nil {
					var admitted bool
					admitted, e = l.TryAdmit(ctx, nil)
					out["admitted"] = admitted
					var paused *queuegate.PausedError
					out["paused"] = errors.As(e, &paused)
				} else {
					e = fmt.Errorf("missing lease")
				}
			case "cancel":
				if l := leases[req.ID]; l != nil {
					out["cancel_requested"], e = l.CancellationRequested(ctx)
				} else {
					e = fmt.Errorf("missing lease")
				}
			case "retire":
				if l := leases[req.ID]; l != nil {
					out["interrupted"], e = l.RetireOutcome(ctx, "")
					if e == nil {
						delete(leases, req.ID)
					}
				} else {
					e = fmt.Errorf("missing lease")
				}
			case "orphan":
				if l := leases[req.ID]; l != nil {
					e = l.Close()
					delete(leases, req.ID)
				} else {
					e = fmt.Errorf("missing lease")
				}
			default:
				e = fmt.Errorf("unknown action")
			}
		}
		cancel()
		if e != nil {
			out["error"] = e.Error()
		}
		if e = enc.Encode(out); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
	}
	if e := scanner.Err(); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
